ai.overview: Ohio State puts the lineal championship belt on the line for the first time in this reign when they host Michigan on November 1st, 2026. The Buckeyes claimed the belt just one day prior with a 5–2 victory over these same Wolverines. Michigan, who have held the belt 5 times previously, will look to immediately reclaim what they lost in Columbus.
key_matchups: Can Ohio State repeat their 5–2 formula from just one day ago against the same opponent?
Michigan enters 7-1 on the season versus Ohio State's 3-4 record, but the Wolverines just suffered their first loss
Ohio State are 0-0 in belt defenses this reign after winning it on 2026-10-31
ai.betting_angles: Michigan hold a commanding 31-21-5 edge in the all-time series and boast a 7-1 record this season compared to Ohio State's 3-4 mark. However, the Buckeyes just beat Michigan 5–2 in their most recent meeting on 2026-10-31. The Elo model still favors Michigan despite that recent result, suggesting the numbers see Ohio State as overachieving in that win.
ai.prediction_writeup: While Ohio State won 5–2 just one day ago, their 3-4 overall record and status as the Elo underdog suggest that result may have been an outlier. Michigan's 7-1 season and historical dominance in this rivalry (31-21-5 all-time) point to a regression. The Wolverines won four straight before their recent loss, including a 7–2 victory over Alaska Anchorage and back-to-back wins at Denver by 4–1 and 4–3 margins. Look for Michigan to bounce back and reclaim the belt in the rematch.
